cd /code && Rscript -e "df<-read.csv('preregSR_dataClean.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE); disciplineFrame<-df |>
  dplyr::group_by(discipline) |>
  dplyr::summarize(k_articles=dplyr::n(), n_studies=sum(denom, na.rm=TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(k_articles), dplyr::desc(n_studies)); print(disciplineFrame); addFrame <- data.frame(Analysis=c('Percentage of studies with at least one outcome discrepancy that disclose an outcome discrepancy','Percentage of outcome discrepancies that favored statistically significant results','Likelihood ratio of a study with versus without an outcome discrepancy to contain statistically significant results','*Likelihood ratio of a study with versus without a statistically significant results to contain an outcome discrepancy','Likelihood ratio of a study with versus without industry funded to contain an outcome discrepancy','Likelihood ratio of a prospectively registered study versus retrospectively registered study to contain a primary outcome discrepancy'), n=c(sum(!is.na(df$disclosedNum)),sum(!is.na(df$favorSig)),sum(!is.na(df$sigDisc)),sum(!is.na(df$sigDisc)),sum(!is.na(df$industryDisc)),sum(!is.na(df$proDisc)))); print(addFrame);"
